title: 赛季截止公告
excerpt: 2025/26下学期赛季即将结束，可以登记进入个人分表中的友谊赛的截止日期为7月2日（含7月2日）。2026/27上学期赛季开始时间初步定为9月1日。
content: 2025/26下学期赛季即将结束，可以登记进入个人分表中的友谊赛的截止日期为7月2日（含7月2日）。2026/27上学期赛季开始时间初步定为9月1日。
excerpt_en: The 2025/26 second-semester season is about to end. The deadline for registering friendly matches that count towards the individual points table is 2 July (2 July inclusive). The 2026/27 first-semester season is provisionally scheduled to start on 1 September.
content_en: The 2025/26 second-semester season is about to end. The deadline for registering friendly matches that count towards the individual points table is 2 July (2 July inclusive). The 2026/27 first-semester season is provisionally scheduled to start on 1 September.
